title: Durable Execution — Why Agents Need Durability
titleKn: Durable Execution — Agents ಗೆ ಬಾಳಿಕೆ ಏಕೆ
desc: Long-running agents hit crashes, timeouts and deployments, so their progress must survive interruptions.
objectives: Explain what is lost when a long process crashes.
objectivesKn: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್ ಆದಾಗ ಏನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Durable Execution — Event History and Replay
titleKn: Durable Execution — Event ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಮತ್ತು Replay
desc: Workflows are made durable by logging events and replaying them to rebuild state after a restart.
objectives: Explain why workflow code must be deterministic on replay.
objectivesKn: replay ನಲ್ಲಿ workflow ಕೋಡ್ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಏಕೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Durable Execution — Idempotency, Timers and Human Waits
titleKn: Durable Execution — Idempotency, Timers, ಮಾನವ ಕಾಯುವಿಕೆ
desc: Durable workflows must make side effects safe to retry and handle long waits such as human approval.
objectives: Use idempotency keys for side effects.
Wait for humans or timers without holding resources.
objectivesKn: side effects ಗೆ idempotency keys ಬಳಸಿ.
ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಹಿಡಿಯದೆ ಮಾನವ ಅಥವಾ timers ಗೆ ಕಾಯಿರಿ.
